purpose: Ownership lanes for parallel AI sessions. A session works in one lane and edits only that lane's files; a change another lane needs goes to that lane as a short note. One session per lane at a time.
supersedes: The integration_rule in docs/FEDERATION_SCENARIO_HANDOFFS.json: scenarios no longer need an integrator, because shared code reads each scenario's meta (docs/ADDING_A_SCENARIO.md).
build: Bundles in dist/ built from src/ are not committed; run python3 tools/build_sources.py (or node tools/build_sources.cjs).
behavior_check: node tools/scenario_sim.cjs --all must reproduce tools/data/sim_baseline.txt unless the change is meant to alter play; then regenerate it in the same commit and say why.

shared_lines: dist/scenario-manifest.js: its own SCENARIO_MANIFEST line and SCENARIO_FILES entries

lanes.work: combat, movement, economy, saves, victory, Elite setup
doctrines, production, naval, tactical orders; new scenario behaviors as named meta.ai switches
rendering, underlays, meta.map overlays, drawing speed
World Campaign tiers and objectives, Story Mode missions
unit, commander and research data; world map; art
